site.label: Site
site.offChart: Time-stretched replay of a published simulation. The array stays passive.
narration: The array is quiet. Passive microphones only, wind domain, propeller source in the published run. Wind across the array is about 5 m/s.
Nothing has crossed the RMS gate. What the array hears is wind and sensor noise.
Level crosses the gate on the western side. No scheduled flight accounts for it.
SRP-PHAT locks a bearing. On the published run the mean bearing error is 0.0°.
The track is confirmed. This run detected 97% of its windows.
The classifier leads with a small craft, confidence 0.19. That is under the reject threshold, so the contact stays on the picture.
The contact is inside the array sector and still unexplained. The console proposes. Only the officer chooses.

decisions.label: Hold the western approach
decisions.note: Stop movement on the bearing until the contact is identified

decisions.label: Notify site security
decisions.note: Page the site lead with the bearing, range and track

decisions.label: Log as an authorized flight
decisions.note: Keeps the track, marks it explained, and stores the label

decisions.label: Keep monitoring
decisions.note: Stays at tier 4 and asks again in 2 min

site.closing: The officer's decision labels this track. The array never transmits.

range.label: Range
range.offChart: Replay only. No engagement is computed or cued from this screen.
narration: Routine acoustic picture. wind domain, propeller source, passive array. Wind across the array is about 5 m/s.
RMS gate closed. Ambient wind noise only.
Unscheduled contact, western arc. The gate is open.
Bearing locked by SRP-PHAT. Published mean error 0.0°.
Track confirmed. Detection rate on this run 97%.
Classification confidence 0.19, below the threshold that would drop a non-drone. Contact retained.
Inside the array sector, unexplained. The console recommends. The officer decides.

decisions.label: Hold movement in the array sector
decisions.note: Keep people and vehicles out of the sector

decisions.label: Cue a response team to the bearing
decisions.note: Send a team to look, using the passive fix

decisions.label: Log as an authorized flight
decisions.note: Keeps the track, marks it explained, and stores the label

decisions.label: Keep monitoring
decisions.note: Stays at tier 4 and asks again in 2 min

range.closing: The officer's decision labels this track. The system takes no action on its own.
